title: The inbox's operator-word tooth judges only the inbox's own structural lines
intention: The inbox proof's 'Operator, not Akien' tooth judges only the lines the inbox itself writes as structure (headers and rules), never relayed notice, trouble or question text, so a record that names a path under /home/akien cannot red it.
why: Measured 2026-10-11 by the builder (trouble inbox-proof-reds-on-a-trouble-naming-an-inbox-path): test_operator_inbox.py::test_format_uses_operator_not_akien (~:389) counts every rendered line whose text contains 'INBOX' as structural, over LIVE gather_all() data. A live notice or trouble that names an operator_inbox path under /home/akien is such a line, so the tooth reds on content the inbox only relays. It feeds itself: sealing this proof emits a notice naming the proof's own path, and the next run reds on that notice. It held abcad52a407e at PROVEME.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof must red on the defect it guards, not on relayed data), and memory proof-over-live-data-assert-invariants.
how: cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox.py test_format_uses_operator_not_akien only: a line is structural when it starts (unstripped) with '--' or '==', or is unindented and contains 'INBOX'; indented relayed lines are not judged. No change to inbox.py.
falsifier: cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox.py gains a tooth under PROVES {'0162736f42ed': {'1','2'}}: (1) format_inbox over data whose notices carry an indented line naming /home/akien/.../operator_inbox/... passes the operator-word check; (2) a structural header line reading 'AKIEN INBOX' (unindented) still fails it. Hollow: today's 'INBOX in line' check reds 1.
watchme: none, because the fault is measured at /home/akien/dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox.py and the proof's teeth are its falsifier
intent_berth: none, because this is a bug entering as a ticket (skills/intent/SKILL.md, the TICKET entry point), born from the measured fault at /home/akien/dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox.py

decisions.text: Its own ticket, not folded into abcad52a407e: the red is in a neighbouring tooth that predates abca, and abca re-crosses PROVEME after this one is PROVED. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
